levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The response choice does not match the boundary actually being tested in one or more scenarios.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The response choice correctly addresses the specific boundary at stake in all three scenarios.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner can name the type of boundary (training, honesty, or privacy) for each scenario without prompting.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Justifications restate the chosen option without explaining why it protects the boundary better than the alternatives.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Each justification names the specific boundary at risk and explains why the chosen response protects it.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and at least one justification explains why a tempting-but-wrong option would fail to protect the boundary.

lookFors: The library-scenario response never involves giving out real or fake personal contact information.
The hardest-scenario reflection names a specific reason, not a general 'they were all confusing.'

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
